gwt.given: data is the 5-byte span [0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x2A] with position = 3, so only 2 bytes (indices 3-4) remain ahead of the cursor -- fewer than the 4 an Int32 requires -- even though the span's total length of 5 is not itself less than 4
gwt.when: TryConvertFromBytes(ref data, ref position, typeof(int), out result) is called
gwt.then: the length guard compares against the full 5-byte span rather than the 2 bytes remaining from position 3 and passes, then the conversion of the 2-byte remainder to Int32 throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException instead of TryConvertFromBytes returning false
